lines.en: I cross cracked sand.

lines.zh: 我宽阔的身子把影子压得很低
lines.en: My broad body presses my shadow low.

lines.zh: 我的关节走起来有金属的响
lines.en: My joints sound like metal when I walk.

lines.zh: 恶地的红岩从我身边过
lines.en: Red badland rock passes beside me.
Every step lands solidly.

lines.zh: 在沙漠里，我朝着低处走
lines.en: In the desert I head for low ground.
My tail trails behind me.
Sand runs into little heaps at my feet.
I slowly go around broken stone.

lines.zh: 在灵魂沙峡谷，我走得更慢
lines.en: In the soul sand valley I go slower.

lines.zh: 我的影子在山壁上移动
lines.en: My shadow moves along the rock wall.
I lift my head and sniff.
The wind is all ash and dust.
I lower my head and walk on.
I stand at the cliff edge, motionless.
A layer of ash on my hide.
I keep watch near my anchor.

lines.zh: 金属的关节有时会响一声
lines.en: A metal joint ticks now and then.
Dry country. Good for hiding.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把重心换到另一侧
lines.en: I shift my weight to the other side.
Wind crosses the dunes far off.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在阴影里发暗
lines.en: My eyes go dark in the shadow.
Bits of rock still lodge in my claw tips
They've dug a great deal of stone.
I raise my head and scan again.
Nothing moving.
Then I'll stand a while longer.
Until something moves.
I turn my head; my eyes meet yours.
In the sand you stand out clearly.
I'm much broader than you.

lines.zh: 这里的风会带走气味，但带不走你
lines.en: The wind takes smells, but not you.

lines.zh: 两格半的成熟体，能驮人。
lines.en: Two and a half blocks, and rideable.
Sand gives a little under me.
You didn't run. That's uncommon.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上刮了一下
lines.en: My claws scrape once at the ground.
The Giga Destroyer is charging.

lines.zh: 你可以在边上走，别过来
lines.en: You may pass along the edge. Not through.
My head sinks slowly.
Watching you, saying nothing.
If you understand, back off.
If not, that's all right.
I'll make it clear to you.
Then we start now.
The hit turns my body aside.
A crack appears in a plate.
I growl, low and muffled.
Sand gets into the wound.
I give half a step; the print is deep.
That made me look at you again.

lines.zh: 我把重心放低，炮口朝下。
lines.en: I lower my stance, cannon aimed down.
A joint knocks once.
You're still standing. Good.
Then I'll be serious.
That thing doesn't stand out in sand.
You hold it up. Now I see it.

lines.zh: 我只对能挖的石头有兴趣
lines.en: Only stone worth digging interests me
But it interests me somewhat.
Set it on the stone and back off.
I walk over and nudge it.
This is hard. I like it.
What lies under sand, I keep.
You'd better not come looking.
It's mine now.

lines.zh: 沙会记住位置，我记得住
lines.en: Sand keeps the spot. So do I.
You'd better leave first.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，几乎没声
lines.en: You hit me with almost no sound.
My body is like a stone.
You bounce off and sit down in the sand.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我抬了下眼皮
lines.en: That made me raise an eyelid.
I look down at you a long while.
I shift half a step and you back away.
Our scuffing raises sand.

lines.zh: 我的爪子没有离开地面
lines.en: My claws never left the ground.
Don't come at me from the side.
I don't like that.
Only one of me in this stretch.
We seldom gather in groups.
Though two isn't bad either.

lines.zh: 你走在我后面，沙会少些
lines.en: Walk behind me; less sand will hit you.

lines.zh: 我的锚点在那块岩石下
lines.en: My anchor is under that rock.
The sand goes cold at night.
Stay on my side.
My words have always been few.
But I won't walk off.
Unless there's mining to do.
I flick it up on a claw tip.

lines.zh: 这东西进了我的爪子就变形
lines.en: It deforms as soon as I grip it.

lines.zh: 我把它埋起来，留个记号
lines.en: I bury it and leave a mark.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西我看在眼里
lines.en: I saw what you dropped.
I bury it in the sand to dig up later.
This core sample goes into my plate seam
I shove it aside with a claw.
Little use, but I won't toss it.
Whatever I dig up is mine.
That's the rule around here.
You're in my path.
I square my body around.
My claws dig into the sand first.
This lunge will come down heavy.
Sand will drag at your feet.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌比你的大得多
lines.en: My feet are far wider than yours.
You've backed to the broken stone.
The stones won't stop me.

lines.zh: 你把身子转正，爪子先挖进沙里。
lines.en: I square up and drive my claws into the sand.
No hurry. This place is empty.
Shout and no one answers.
Now I've arrived.
I track you along the sand ridge.
You go down; I take the low line.

lines.zh: 你在沙上留下的印很清
lines.en: Your prints in the sand are clear.
Mine are deeper.
The wind covers my sound.
You look back and don't see me.
A dune stands in between.
Once round it, I'm close.
A few more steps and you're in a dead end.
That's a cliff wall. No way out.
Then let's take this moment.

lines.zh: 沙陷下去，我的脚印很深
lines.en: The sand gives way; my prints go deep
My claw strikes your shoulder.

lines.zh: 这一扑压上了全身的分量
lines.en: This lunge bears my whole weight.

lines.zh: 你被推进沙里，陷了半脚
lines.en: You're driven into the sand, half a foot deep.
My headbutt lands on your chest.
Sand sprays up and blinds you briefly.
I raise the other claw.
Your armour cracks audibly.
You retreat, leaving a groove.
I follow slowly after.
You can still stand. Good.
Then I press once more.
Let this one finish it.
Sand settles on my shoulders and I ignore it

lines.zh: 我的身子把风挡了一下
lines.en: My body blocks the wind for a moment.
Ash settles on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 这一带通常只有一两头
lines.en: Usually only one or two of us here.
I take my place by the rock.
Sand is still sliding underfoot.
I lift my head and look around.

lines.zh: 我的影子在沙上拖得很长
lines.en: My shadow drags long across the sand
I dig my claws into the sand first.
That's what keeps me steady.
I'm in no hurry to go over.
Let it come closer itself.
The wind grows drier each time.
A slow breath in, then begin.

lines.zh: 火烤得我的甲发烫，干沙还贴在脚上。
lines.en: Fire heats my armor, dry sand still on my feet.

lines.zh: 我砸进沙里，扬起一大片
lines.en: I crash into the sand, throwing up a sheet of it.

lines.zh: 水灌进关节里，动起来发涩
lines.en: Water in my joints makes them grind.
The blast slides me sideways.
An arrow jams in a seam of my back plate.
That light went around my plates.
Too starved to lift a claw.

lines.zh: 雷打在沙上，我整具身子一僵
lines.en: Lightning hits the sand and my whole body seizes.
No sand. No rock wall.
